reason:
Under the transfer/leakage lens the idea survives on HARM but not on its SIZE claims. The gain does not come from the node multiplier: forks are skipped, there is a 0.5% node cap, and the owner-propagation sim is pure FN-side edge accounting. It does not come from trusting in-sample network scores either, because the chooser is geometric. And by construction it comes from crop redundancy, which is a no-op when there is none: exact voxel equality and at least 5 overlapping frames give zero false registrations.

Measured today (scratchpad oc_xfer.py / oc_xfer2.py / oc_xfer3.py, exp39+ef 44b6 match files):
(1) The owner rule reproduces net +89 (144 fixed / 55 broken, accuracy 0.72). 64 of the +89 come from non-owner copies within 3 um or 3 frames of a crop border (accuracy 0.77). No discordant case has a non-owner score of 15 or more. A score gap under 3 is a coin flip: gap [0,1) nets -1 (acc 0.44), gap [1,3) nets 0 (acc 0.50). The rule 'gap >= 3 and non-owner < 8' keeps +78 at accuracy 0.77.
(2) The border effect that the chooser relies on exists only in the first ~3 um or frames. Single-copy 44b6 FN rate: z<3 um 8.3% vs 4.7% interior, t<3 frames 6.8% vs 4.9%, xy<3 um no excess. The 3-15 um bins sit at baseline. This truncated context (padding, temporal window) is an architectural effect, so it plausibly transfers to unseen embryos.
(3) In-sample, the two copies fail almost INDEPENDENTLY: 9.1% of multi-copy edges are discordant and 1.1% are FN in every copy, against 10.4% / 0.3% if they were fully independent. Most in-sample errors are therefore context or phase noise around a memorised interior. Out of sample, a larger share of errors will be input-determined: identical input, both copies fail, unfixable. Any extra context-noise discordance is a coin flip for the chooser. So the claim that test discordance and headroom are 'probably larger' is unsupported. Extra discordance adds splice volume and seam risk, not net gain.
(4) Concentration: leak group 0 (24 overlapping crops of one region) holds 67 of the +89. Without it the ceiling is +22 FN units, about +0.001 on a 44b6-type embryo.
(5) Density: the hidden test has ~100-130 clips (CONTEXT l.14) and the public set is ~29%, so ~30-38 clips for the public embryo against 71 in 44b6 train. Overlapping pairs grow roughly with N^2, so a 44b6-type public embryo with ~35 clips would have about half the multi-copy share (22% -> ~11%). Its ceiling would be ~+0.002, not +0.004 (assumption: same recording size and crop sampler).

The direction should hold on an overlapping unseen embryo: bit-identical input, border truncation is architectural, geometric chooser. But the realistic expectation is small, and it cannot move the public score materially toward 0.97. Not refuted because the lens-specific failure modes (in-sample net trust, node multiplier, a leak that exists only in train) are either absent or neutralised by the no-op guarantee. The remaining risk is magnitude, not sign, provided the coin-flip zone is excluded.
fix_if_any:
(a) Restrict splicing to the in-sample evidence zone. Splice a component only if the non-owner copy's mean score is < 8-10 (um or frames) AND the owner-minus-non-owner gap is >= 3 (not the 1 um hysteresis). In-sample this keeps +78 of +89 and removes the coin-flip region (gap < 3 nets -1). It also stops the pass from acting on interior phase or context discordance that will appear out of sample, where the chooser has no signal.
(b) Lab readouts: report the result with and without leak group 0, splice volume (components replaced) vs net fixes, the node-ratio and multiplier term separately, and 6bba bit-identity. The gate should require that the ex-group-0 subset is non-negative.
(c) Drop the 'test headroom is larger' claim and downgrade expected gain to the numbers below.
(d) Run the structure bit-probe (registration only; raise on >= 1 exact-overlap pair among the hidden test clips, with the >= 5-frame rule) BEFORE spending the engineering day. It is the only out-of-sample transfer test available, it answers the question for public and private at once, and it costs one submission (needs user approval). If there is no overlap, the line is dead at zero engineering cost.
(e) Keep the fallback: on any exception, or a node rise > 0.5%, write the untouched csv.
realistic_public_gain: Unconditional expectation about +0.0003 to +0.001 public. With P(public embryo overlap-rich) ~0.5 (a guess), a conditional ~+0.001-0.002 on a 44b6-type embryo with fewer clips than train (ceiling scaled by ~35/71 clip density, minus seam losses), and 0 on a 6bba-type embryo. Private: similar conditional +0.001-0.003 if a private embryo is 44b6-type with train-like clip density. Harm risk ~0 given exact-voxel registration, fork skip, node cap and the gap >= 3 restriction. This cannot close the 0.948 -> 0.97 gap; it is a cheap add-on plus a structural diagnostic.
